summary.text: Llew Jones is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives, District 18, who is not seeking re-election to that seat and is instead the Republican candidate for Montana State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Appropriations Committee and previously served in the State Senate from 2011 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Llew Jones earned a bachelor's degree and, in 1988, an M.S. in economics from Montana State University.
His professional experience includes working as a partner at Frontline Agriculture in 2006 and owning Pure Bliss Cycles, Pondera RV Park, Jathco Systems, and Jones Ranch.
Jones served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2005 to 2011 and in the Montana State Senate, District 9, from 2011 to 2019.
He returned to the House on January 7, 2019, succeeding Rob Cook.
Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and chair of the Education Committee in 2019-2020, and as Appropriations chair in the three sessions since.
